correctness.rationale: Reconstructed stationary age mixture U=exp(-κT) with U density q u^(q-1) and conditional X|U=u∼N(mu,v+du²), where q=r/κ>0, v=D/κ>0 and d=σ²−v>−v. Independently expanded all raw moments up to degree 4, formed the fourth cumulant and symbolically verified exactly the given rational A,B,C and positive quadratic discriminant 288q²(q²−2q+3)/[(q+1)^4(q+2)^2(q+3)^2(q+4)^2]. A changes sign at positive roots of q³−q²−6q+2, approximately 0.321637 and 2.855773; B changes sign at (√13−1)/2, between those roots. For d≠0, t=m²/|d| yields quadratic A t²+6sgn(d)B t+3C, with positive constant and discriminant. Vieta signs prove exactly two positive simple roots only in the two stated open regimes, one when A<0, and the asserted endpoint linear cases; d=0 is separate. Verified exact q=4 witness polynomial (13t²−850t+4375)/26250. No mistaken inference of Gaussianity from κ4=0.
